title: Honours, peerages and memberships (data/elections/persons/honours.json)
description: What a person was made or appointed to that is not an office with duties of its own and not a seat won at an election Civgraph holds: a peerage, a knighthood or other honour, the Privy Council, a lieutenancy, or a seat in an appointed or indirectly chosen body (the Senate of Northern Ireland, Seanad Éireann, the nominated European Parliament of 1973-79, the EU Committee of the Regions, the Parliamentary Assembly of the Council of Europe). Each is dated and cited; a date the sources do not give is null, and precision is the precision of the date as given.

title.description: The honour, title or seat, in Civgraph's words ("Life peer: Baron Molyneaux of Killead", "Senator, Seanad Éireann (nominated by the Taoiseach)").

body.description: The body it is a place in or conferred by (House of Lords, Seanad Éireann, Order of the British Empire).

startBy.description: Where the start is not known: the date a source shows it already held (start is then null).

matchedBy.description: How the person was identified: the evidence, never the name alone.
